# Learning beside someone who can intervene

Supported practice works when help is close enough that a mistake does not become a public crisis. That is different from being watched by an assessor. Ask the newcomer which tasks they want to attempt next. [[Listening]] should include how a helper can be present without taking over, and how to withdraw support without making it a surprise.
